title: NumPy Sheet
blurb: Twenty-five short exercises that take you from building arrays to writing loop-free data transforms. Each problem uses one core NumPy idea on a small, realistic task: padding token batches, cutting image patches, forward-filling sensor gaps, finding the lag between two signals.
prereq: You should be comfortable writing Python functions with lists and loops; no NumPy experience is assumed.
next: Next, try the Linear Algebra plan, where these array skills become matrix factorisations, then build full models from scratch in Cracking ML.
